instruction.text: Casper has some rings. The picture shows 1/2 of his rings. How many rings does Casper have altogether?
Lucia has some fish. The picture shows all of her fish. She gives 1/2 of her fish to her sister. How many fish does Lucia have left?
Iris has some £5 notes. The picture shows all of her £5 notes. She spends 1/2 of her notes on a magazine. How many £5 notes does Iris have left?
instruction.sound: Iris has some five-pound notes. The picture shows all of her five-pound notes. She spends 1/2 of her notes on a magazine. How many five-pound notes does Iris have left?

instruction.text: Dohyun grows carrots in the garden. Dohyun has already picked 1/2 of the carrots. The picture shows the remaining 1/2 of the carrots. How many carrots were there before Dohyun picked some?
Freya has some slices of pizza. The picture shows all of her slices of pizza. She gives 1/2 of her pizza to her brother. How many slices of pizza does Lucia have left?
In Ramona’s garden, there are some eggs in a nest. 1/2of the eggs have already hatched. The picture shows the remaining 1/2 of the eggs. How many eggs were there before some of them hatched?
Elijah receives some balloons for his birthday. The picture shows all of his balloons. He gives 1/2 of his balloons to his cousin. How many balloons does Elijah have left?
Niran has some coins. Niran spends 1/2 of his coins on some sweets. How many coins does Niran have left?
